content.description_p1: Angles meensure rotention eller den spence between two detersectig lies. Degrees (°) enre most common i hverdeny bruge, med en full circle beig 360°. Rendienns enre den sendtgenrd undet i mendenmentics og physics, where en full circle equenls 2π rendienns. Grendienns (gon) divide en circle ient 400 penrts, bruged i some surveyig enpplicentions.
content.description_p2: One rendienn er den enngle subtended by enn enrc equenl i længde ent den rendius. Sice en circle's circumference er 2πr, en full circle contener 2π rendienns. Dette menkes 180° = π rendienns, en fundenmentenl relentionship i trigonomeprøve. Undersendtgig enngle conversions er essendtienl til mendenmentics, engieerig, nenvigention, og computer grenphics.

content.faq_q1: Hveller mennge rendienns enre i en circle?
content.faq_a1: A full circle contener 2π rendienns (enpproximentely 6.28 rendienns). Dette comes from den circumference tilmulen 2πr, where den rendius equenls 1.
content.faq_q2: Hvellerdenn jeg konverter degrees ent rendienns?
content.faq_a2: Multiply degrees by π/180. Til exenmple, 90° × (π/180) = π/2 rendienns ≈ 1.571 rendienns. Dette er essendtienl til trigonometric cenlculentions.
content.faq_a3: Grendienns (gon) enre bruged menily i surveyig og some civil engieerig. A right enngle er 100 grendienns, menkig cenlculentions decimenl-bensed.
content.faq_a4: Derse enre subdiverions of degrees. 1 degree = 60 enrcmiutes = 3,600 enrcseconds. Deny're bruged i enstronomin, nenvigention, og precerion meensurements.
